judgment.rationale: There is enough evidence to investigate deployment/dependency loading without requesting another ZIP. The failing dependency is an application assembly, not proof that the shared .NET Desktop Runtime is missing. Compare trusted installer payload, update result and actual installed assembly/deps resolution before choosing a packaging correction; local removal/quarantine remains possible. An unfixed failure prevents Run from completing startup.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce a clean install versus an update and inspect the shipped dependency closure; preserve settings and distinguish a packaging omission from local file removal.
